'''Chompy birds''' are monsters that can only be killed after completion of [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]]. They can only be attacked with the [[Comp ogre bow|composite ogre bow]] or [[ogre bow]] equipped with [[brutal arrows]] or [[ogre arrow]]s. [[Bloated toad]]s must be dropped on the ground as bait to attract them. Chompy birds spawn in a 10 [[game square]] radius around the bloated toad (21x21 game square). A chompy bird will leave if it is not killed after one minute. 

When a chompy bird is killed, a message says: "You scratch a notch on your bow for the chompy bird kill." When a chompy dies, it leaves a corpse, which can be plucked to gain [[feather]]s. Doing this will also place a [[raw chompy]] and some [[bones]] on the ground.

Players have a 25%/50%/75%/100% chance to spawn an additional chompy bird while hunting chompy birds, respectively if easy/medium/hard/elite [[Ardougne achievements]] are completed.

[[Cannons]] can target and kill chompy birds if the cannon's owner has one of the required bows equipped.

After 30 kills, the player can wear [[chompy hat]]s. Upon reaching 4,000 kills, players will be rewarded with 30,000 [[Ranged]] experience (which can be increased with [[bonus experience]]). Killing 30 chompy birds is a requirement for obtaining the [[master quest cape]], and killing 4,000 chompy birds is a requirement for the [[Completionist cape (t)|trimmed completionist cape]].

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch Notes (18 July 2016)|date=18 July 2016}}
** Allowed use of abilities on chompy and jubbly birds.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (5 May 2015)|date=5 May 2015}}
** Chompy birds no longer appear to have 1 lifepoint when defeated.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (28_January_2013)|date=28 January 2013}}
** Players will now continuously attack Chompy birds and will no longer be told that the bird they were attacking is not their target.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (26 September 2012)|date=26 September 2012}} 
** Certain messages have been removed while Chompy bird hunting to prevent spamming.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (31 August 2011)|date=31 August 2011}}
** Chompy birds now work correctly with the bonecrusher.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch_Notes_(16 February 2010)|date=16 February 2010}}
** Corrected the timing when cooking chompy bird meat on a spit.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (16 June 2009)|date=16 June 2009}}
** Prevented certain bubbles in the Feldip Hills from blocking Ranged attacks when hunting chompies and jubbly chompies.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Big Chompy Bird Hunting|date=18 May 2004}}
** Added to game.

==Trivia==
* The chompy bird's appearance is similar to that of the extinct {{Wp|dodo}}.
* The chompy bird's name possibly comes from the Nicaraguan word for ''Turkey, ''"Chompipe", pronounced "chom-''pea-''pay''".''
* It previously could not be [[Monster Examine]]d. This might have been because it does not attack the player. However, it is now possible, and states that this monster has a max hit of 8.
